channel.title: Nordic Crypto
channel.description: Bitcoin-, Blockchain- und Krypto-Nachrichten aus Norwegen, Schweden, Dänemark, Finnland und Island, mit englischen Zusammenfassungen, einem Veranstaltungskalender und einem Wer-ist-wer.

item.title: Die USA gehen daran, mehr als 1,2 Milliarden Dollar aus dem Binance-Hack zu beschlagnahmen oder einzufrieren
item.description:
The US Department of Justice said on 12 November 2026 that a court has authorised the seizure or freezing of more than 1.2 billion US dollars in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance. More than 2.7 billion dollars have already been frozen. The FBI attributes the theft to the North Korean group it calls TraderTraitor. The same DOJ release also covers a separate scheme, FaceStealer, in which fake video meetings were used to steal more than 400 million dollars over 18 months; that is not a new Binance theft.

Quelle: VG

item.title: Flamman berichtet über Verbindungen zu Zahlungsunternehmen um den angeklagten früheren Valuno-Chef
item.description:
According to Flamman's own investigation, companies and people around Valuno's former chief executive, Daniel Sonesson, have continued to operate in payments, including services used by online casinos. Sweden's Economic Crime Authority has charged Sonesson with aggravated insider trading, and he denies wrongdoing, according to Svenska Dagbladet. The company and person links Flamman reports are the paper's own findings.

Quelle: Flamman

item.title: Bitcoin is time: a clock without a clockmaker
item.description:
Andreas Schjønhaug gave a talk at Litteraturhuset in Oslo on 11 November 2026, arranged by Bitcoinpolitisk institutt Norge, with comments from philosopher Sæbjørn Forberg. The lecture argues that money stores the value of work across time, and that Bitcoin is best understood as a clock in which each tick requires proof-of-work. It follows that idea from Vinje's phrase that money is frozen human sweat, through earlier energy-money proposals by writers such as H.G. Wells and Henry Ford, to Satoshi Nakamoto's 2008 design of a shared ledger that keeps a common history without a central timekeeper.

Quelle: Enogtjue

item.title: Yle: Weniger als jeder sechste finnische Krypto-Händler gibt seine Geschäfte an
item.description:
Yle reports that the Finnish tax office says fewer than one in six crypto traders in Finland declare their trades. That share has not been confirmed in the tax authority's published notes on the new reporting duty. From next year the authority is due to receive data from Finnish and foreign crypto-asset service providers, according to Vero.fi.

Quelle: Yle Uutiset

item.title: Axiology erhält erweiterte MiFID-Zulassung für tokenisierte Vermögenswerte
item.description:
Lithuania's Axiology has received an expanded MiFID authorisation from the Bank of Lithuania (Lietuvos bankas) covering the reception, transmission and execution of client orders, according to the company as reported by Kaupr. The firm says the change lets institutions subscribe and redeem units in tokenised money-market funds directly through it. Axiology already operates under the EU DLT Pilot Regime.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa bestätigt Cyberangriff; Ermittler ZachXBT meldete Krypto-Abhebungen
item.description:
Crédit Mutuel Arkéa has confirmed a cyberattack carried out through a service provider's platform, and said the funds may then have been converted into cryptocurrency, according to the bank's statement of 4 November 2026. Blockchain investigator ZachXBT first flagged large unauthorised withdrawals from crypto-exchange accounts, Realtid reports, citing figures of about 133 million US dollars; the bank has not confirmed that amount and said it could only validate the order of magnitude.

Quelle: Realtid

item.title: Norwegische Regierung plant Genehmigungspflicht für Rechenzentren; Kryptoaktivität gilt nicht als gesellschaftlich nützlich
item.description:
The Norwegian government will start work on a licensing scheme for data centres, according to a 9 November 2026 press release from the Ministry of Digitalisation and Public Governance and the Ministry of Energy. Facilities used for crypto activity will not be treated as socially beneficial, the government said. It aims to present the main principles in the autumn of 2027. Statnett has separately paused new grid reservations for data centres.

Quelle: Shifter

item.title: NBX und Aprikos Venture beantragen in Pakistan die Genehmigung der Börse Nayapaisa
item.description:
Norwegian Block Exchange (NBX) and Aprikos Venture have signed a joint venture for a planned Pakistan crypto exchange, Nayapaisa, and have applied to the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority for a No Objection Certificate, according to the companies as reported by Kaupr. The application is the first step in a licensing process, and the exchange will not serve customers until both the certificate and a licence are granted. The plan is to offer deposits and withdrawals in Pakistani rupees through licensed Pakistani banks.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: OKXICE-Mitteilung listet 67 Emittenteneinwände gegen tokenisierte Aktien, darunter Meta und Palantir
item.description:
OKXICE's public notice dated 5 November 2026 lists Notices of Issuer Objection from 67 issuers, including Meta Platforms and Palantir Technologies, according to the document published by OKXICE. The notice follows earlier reporting that disclosed objections had risen to 56 companies. Kryptovalutaguiden covered the update.

Quelle: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Binance-Finanzchef Kaiser Ng tritt zurück; Justin Yek übernimmt
item.description:
Binance co-founder and co-chief executive Yi He said Kaiser Ng is leaving as chief financial officer after more than five years to pursue a new venture, with a transition plan that has been under way for about six months, according to The Block and The Globe and Mail. Justin Yek, previously vice-president of finance at Airwallex, is taking over as CFO. The announcement came days after the late-October theft from Binance; Yi He did not say the departure was caused by the incident.

Quelle: E24

item.title: OFAC benennt acht kanadische Geldtransferunternehmen wegen Iran-bezogener Digitalvermögensaktivität
item.description:
The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control designated eight Canadian money services businesses on 6 November 2026 for helping move value involving Iran and related sanctioned actors through digital assets, according to the Treasury press release. OFAC said some of the firms also handled digital-asset transfers linked to Canadian drug trafficker Ryan Wedding. The designations are part of what Treasury calls Operation Economic Outcast.

Quelle: Finansavisen

item.title: Safello meldet operativen Quartalsgewinn von 0,8 Millionen schwedischen Kronen
item.description:
Safello reported third-quarter operating profit of SEK 0.8 million, according to its figures reported by Kaupr. Revenue fell 41 percent to SEK 98.4 million; the company reported a gross margin of 8.8 percent.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Zeitung berichtet über Kryptotransfers bei Liebesbetrug
item.description:
Ulricehamns Tidning reports that SEK 1.5 million in cryptocurrency was transferred through an intermediary in a romance scam. The publicly accessible excerpt does not establish whether anyone has been charged or convicted.

Quelle: Ulricehamns Tidning

item.title: Norges-Bank-Vertreter fordert Banken zu Tokenisierungsstrategie auf
item.description:
Banks should prepare a tokenisation strategy, Norges Bank's Torbjørn Hægeland said at a conference, according to Kaupr. He said important settlements should use central bank money, including transactions on tokenised platforms.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Norges Bank sieht derzeit keinen Bedarf für digitales Zentralbankgeld für die Öffentlichkeit
item.description:
Norges Bank sees no current need for retail digital central bank money but wants to be ready if that changes, Torbjørn Hægeland told a conference, according to Kaupr. He said a digital euro would not by itself determine Norway's decision.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Handel bei Firi mehr als verdoppelt am Tag nach dem Binance-Hack, laut E24
item.description:
The Norwegian crypto exchange Firi recorded 19.8 million kroner in crypto trading the day after the Binance hack — more than double a typical day — according to figures Firi shared with E24. Activity stayed high over the weekend at 15.4 million kroner, 50 percent above the next-busiest weekend so far this year, chief executive Thuc Hoang told E24. Hoang says it is too early to know whether customers are permanently moving funds from foreign exchanges.

Quelle: E24

item.title: Virtune notiert KI-Krypto-Index-ETP an Nasdaq Stockholm und Xetra
item.description:
Nordic ETP issuer Virtune listed its Virtune AI Crypto Index ETP on 3 November 2026 under the tickers VIRAI on Nasdaq Stockholm and VRTI on Deutsche Börse Xetra, according to Kaupr. The product tracks an index of 13 crypto assets linked to what the industry calls the agent economy. In an interview with Kaupr, Virtune chief sales officer Andreas Severin said the listing reflects the company's view that software agents using blockchain services are becoming a growth driver alongside tokenisation.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Einwände gegen tokenisierte Aktien bei OKXICE steigen auf 56 Unternehmen, darunter Tesla und SpaceX
item.description:
Tesla, SpaceX, Amazon, Netflix, SoFi and Lam Research are among the companies that have objected to their shares being offered as tokens on OKXICE. According to CoinDesk, Decrypt and CoinMarketCap, the number of disclosed objections rose from 50 in a notice on 30 October to 56 in a notice on 2 November. By CoinDesk's tally, 49 of 62 companies have objected.

Quelle: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Binance: Hacker nutzten gefälschte Bewerbungsgespräche und ein internes KI-Werkzeug
item.description:
According to a Binance post on X on 3 November, the attackers behind the recent theft approached an engineer in September with a fake job interview and got him to download a "task" containing malware. Binance says the attackers then used his laptop and misused an internal AI tool to take over the computers of two other engineers. DR reports that Binance has covered 98 percent of the losses; on 31 October Binance said about 90 percent had been replaced.

Quelle: DR

item.title: Hyperliquid-Gründer will US-Händler über regulierte Partner erreichen
item.description:
Hyperliquid had revenue of 713 million US dollars over the past 12 months, Investornytt reports, citing Bloomberg Businessweek. Founder Jeff Yan wants to reach US traders through regulated partners, while CME and ICE have pressed regulators about such platforms; ICE has itself invested in Trade.xyz. According to Event Horizon Labs, fewer than one in four accounts on the platform are profitable.

Quelle: Investornytt

item.title: Firi verlängert Freistellungen bis März 2027 und holt neuen Produktchef
item.description:
The Norwegian crypto exchange Firi says the temporary lay-offs it announced in August will last until the end of March 2027, the maximum of 26 weeks allowed under Norwegian rules, chief executive Thuc Hoang told Kaupr. Hoang says trading activity in 2026 has been lower than the company had planned for. Firi has hired Dino Cehajic, previously at Eika, as chief product officer, and according to Kaupr three key employees have left for other jobs since September.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Zwei frühere Valuno-Manager wegen schweren Insiderhandels angeklagt
item.description:
Sweden's Economic Crime Authority has charged Valuno Group's former chief executive and a former finance director with aggravated insider trading, according to Kaupr and Kryptovalutaguiden. According to the prosecutor, the two learned on 3 July 2025 that Finansinspektionen had refused the subsidiary QB Europe a MiCA licence and sold large parts of their shares before the decision was made public on 4 July, after which the share price fell about 33 percent. Valuno says it is assisting the legal process as needed; no one has been convicted. The charged former chief executive is also a former leader of Medborgerlig Samling and denies wrongdoing, according to SvD; the case is Stockholm District Court B 16085-26.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: NBX hat laut Kaupr mindestens 34 Millionen Kronen von LDA Capital eingeworben
item.description:
The Norwegian crypto exchange NBX has raised at least 34 million Norwegian kroner from the US investor LDA Capital through ten share issues since 2022, according to Kaupr's tally of the company's stock exchange announcements; the latest, closed on 3 November 2026, raised 6.8 million kroner at 0.47 kroner per share. According to NBX's announcements, the money has funded bitcoin purchases and the capital requirements for its e-money licence and its MiCA licence. Under the agreement, NBX decides when to draw on the facility.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Nordkorea weist die Zuordnung des Binance-Hacks durch das FBI zurück
item.description:
North Korea has rejected the FBI's statement that North Korean hackers were behind the theft from Binance, calling it an 'absurd fabrication' in a statement by Kim Yo-jong carried by the state news agency KCNA, according to Yonhap and Bloomberg. The statement calls the attribution a political provocation and suggests it could affect dialogue between North Korea and the United States. The FBI said on 31 October that North Korea's TraderTraitor was responsible and published addresses linked to the stolen funds; the denial is North Korea's position, not a new finding.

Quelle: Aftenposten

item.title: Binance meldet Nettoabflüsse von rund 3,64 Milliarden Dollar nach Wiederöffnung der Auszahlungen
item.description:
According to Binance, customers withdrew a net of about 3.64 billion US dollars between 07:00 and 16:30 CET on 1 November 2026, after the exchange reopened withdrawals following the hack: about 4.65 billion went out and 1.01 billion came in. Binance says this equals about 2.1 percent of its 171 billion dollars in assets and that withdrawals are levelling off. According to CNBC, the stablecoin issuer Circle has now frozen more than 1.1 billion USDC. The analytics service DefiLlama reports higher outflow figures, which Binance disputes because they do not account for its own transfers to new wallets.

Quelle: E24

item.title: Goobit schließt Vereinbarung mit Kvarn Metals über Gold für die Plattform Futureproof
item.description:
Goobit has signed an agreement with Kvarn Metals, which will be the counterparty for gold in its Futureproof savings platform, the company told Kaupr. According to Goobit, the gold is backed 1:1 by physical gold, while bitcoin comes from Kvarn Capital under an agreement made in September. Goobit says both asset classes it needs for launch are now in place.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Binance öffnet Auszahlungen nach dem Hack schrittweise wieder
item.description:
Binance began reopening withdrawals in stages from 07:00 CET on 1 November 2026, and by 13:36 CET all 15 networks in the first phase were open, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain and Solana, according to the exchange. Binance says withdrawals now go out from new wallet addresses and that its Proof of Reserves address list has been updated. The exchange also says that 6 billion US dollars of the loss from the 29 October hack has been covered.

Quelle: Aftenposten

item.title: BPI wirbt dafür, dass Norwegens Ölfonds und Folketrygdfondet Bitcoin prüfen
item.description:
The bitcoin interest group BPI Norge says it has sent two proposals to the Storting as part of its lobbying: that the Government Pension Fund Global report more openly on its indirect bitcoin holdings, and that Folketrygdfondet invest in bitcoin and digital assets, according to Kaupr's report from a BPI webinar on 31 October 2026. BPI says its membership has grown from 150 to 265 and that its secretary general is due to meet the Ministry of Finance; these figures come from BPI and have not been independently verified. Disclosure: Nordic Crypto's publisher, Jørgen S. Notland, shared a referral link to this BPI contest; Kaupr, the source, partners with him and with Nexa, where the publisher's company does development work as a contractor.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Binance: Rund 90 Prozent der gestohlenen Vermögenswerte ersetzt
item.description:
Binance says it has replaced about 90 percent of the assets stolen in the 29 October hack by buying them back with its own funds; the stolen funds themselves have not been returned. According to Binance, the remaining 10 percent are less liquid tokens that will be bought gradually, and it has published a Proof of Reserves snapshot. The exchange also says the transfer from its SAFU emergency fund has been completed.

Quelle: NRK

item.title: FBI: Nordkoreas TraderTraitor steckt hinter dem Binance-Hack
item.description:
The FBI said on 31 October 2026 that North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than 6 billion US dollars in crypto assets from Binance on or about 29 October, and named the activity 'TraderTraitor', which is linked to the Lazarus group. The blockchain analytics firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis had already linked the attack to the same group. According to the FBI, the stolen assets are mainly being converted into Ether, and the FBI, the US Secret Service and IRS-CI are asking crypto service providers to block transactions with the listed addresses.

Quelle: E24

item.title: Coinbase meldet Quartalsgewinn von 719 Millionen Dollar, überwiegend aus Krypto-Gewinnen
item.description:
Coinbase reported net income of 718.7 million US dollars for the third quarter of 2026, up from 432.6 million a year earlier. About 715 million dollars of that came from gains on crypto assets the company holds as investments. Total revenue fell 35 percent from a year earlier to about 1.22 billion dollars.

Quelle: hurbra

item.title: Norwegens Justizministerin und schwedische Experten nach Binance-Hack besorgt
item.description:
Norway's Minister of Justice and Public Security, Astri Aas-Hansen, told Aftenposten and NTB that the Binance theft shows that cybersecurity can in the most serious cases be a matter of public security, and pointed to the government's proposal to strengthen the Norwegian National Security Authority (NSM). Niklas Arvidsson, a professor at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, told SvD that crypto exchanges lack the safeguards of the banking system, such as deposit guarantees and financial supervision. Journalists at TV4 and Dagens Industri said the incident damages trust in the system as a whole.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Binance bestätigt Verlust von rund 6,3 Milliarden Dollar durch Hackerangriff
item.description:
Binance confirms that it lost about 6.3 billion US dollars in the security incident on 29 October 2026, and says about 3 billion of that has been frozen. According to Binance, deposits are working normally and withdrawals are expected to reopen within 48 hours. The exchange says its investigation has found additional points of breach beyond the compromised employee computer identified earlier, and that user losses will be covered from its SAFU emergency fund and its own funds.

Quelle: Investornytt

item.title: Almeland (V) fragt den Finanzminister, was nötig wäre, um Löhne teilweise in Bitcoin auszuzahlen
item.description:
In written question 15:406 (2026–2027), sent on 29 October 2026, Grunde Almeland (Liberal Party, V) asks the finance minister which laws and regulations would have to change for employees to be able to receive part of their salary in bitcoin or other currencies on the same tax terms as salary in kroner, and whether a limited pilot, for example on Svalbard, could be run without such changes. In his reasoning, Almeland writes that more than 10 percent of Norwegians over 16 own digital assets, citing a Norges Bank survey, and that the payment service Revolut has over 500,000 registered users in Norway. The answer is still pending, and Nordic Crypto will follow up when it comes. Disclosure: the question mentions Bitcoinpolitisk institutt (BPI); Nordic Crypto's publisher, Jørgen S. Notland, has promoted a BPI referral campaign.

Quelle: Stortinget

item.title: Galaxy Digital meldet Nettogewinn von 323 Millionen Dollar im dritten Quartal
item.description:
US crypto and data-centre company Galaxy Digital reported net income of 323 million dollars for the third quarter of 2026, after a loss of 85 million dollars in the second quarter. The company attributes the result to its digital-assets business, gains on its investment portfolio and the first full quarter of leasing revenue from its data-centre business.

Quelle: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Schwedens Finansinspektionen sucht Teilnehmer für Leitfadenprojekt zu tokenisiertem Geld
item.description:
Sweden's Finansinspektionen (FI) is inviting interested parties to join a reference group for a new guidance project on tokenised money under its Innovation Compass. The project covers questions that can arise when payments are made using distributed ledger technology (DLT), such as tokenised bank deposits, e-money tokens under MiCA and central bank money on DLT. Kaupr reports that the deadline to register interest is 22 November.

Quelle: Finansinspektionen

item.title: Krypto-Steuerdienst Kryptos startet ChatGPT-Plugin für Portfoliofragen
item.description:
Crypto portfolio and tax service Kryptos has launched a ChatGPT plugin that lets users ask about portfolio value, cost basis, gains and tax figures, with answers drawn from the wallets and exchanges they have connected. According to Kryptos, the plugin cannot trade, transfer or withdraw assets, and using it requires a paid Kryptos plan.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Bitcoin Suisse bereitet nordischen Start mit MiCA-Lizenz vor
item.description:
Bitcoin Suisse (Europe), the EU arm of the Swiss crypto company Bitcoin Suisse, received a MiCA licence in June 2026, which allows it to offer crypto-asset services in the European Economic Area. According to a LinkedIn post by the company's Nordic general manager, cited by Kaupr, it plans to launch in the Nordic countries in early November, ahead of an event in Stockholm on 19 November.

Quelle: Kaupr

item.title: Kautokeino: Grundstück für Rechenzentrum politisch entschieden, Kryptofirma Arctic Core weiter beteiligt
item.description:
In Kautokeino, the mayor says the allocation of a plot for a planned data centre was handled politically, and the crypto company Arctic Core AS is still part of the plans, Ságat reports. According to the municipal director, the company is to test the possibility of a data centre over two years. The story follows earlier Ságat coverage of the company's plans in the municipality.

Quelle: Ságat

item.title: Dänische Coop Bank öffnet Anlagekonten lesend für KI; Bitpanda ergänzt KI-Werkzeuge
item.description:
Danish Coop Bank lets customers connect AI assistants to their investment accounts through an MCP connection, but the bank says the connection is read-only: it can answer questions about holdings but cannot place orders. Coop Bank's investment service covers shares and funds, not crypto. Kaupr also reports that the Austrian crypto platform Bitpanda is opening customer portfolios to ChatGPT and other AI assistants.

Quelle: Kaupr
